France / Megève

Chalets in Megève

Private chalets and apartments in Megève: in the village, at Mont d'Arbois and around Le Jaillet, for families and groups of up to 18 guests. Geneva Airport is about an hour away.

Plan a stay hereAbout Megève
01 / 06

In short

What to know.

  • Twenty-two houses: twenty chalets and two apartments, for 4 to 18 guests
  • In the village centre, at Mont d'Arbois and around Le Jaillet; some let you ski back to the door
  • Many with an indoor pool, a spa or hammam, or a cinema room
  • Geneva Airport about an hour away by car

Why we send guests here

Who it suits.

For families and groups who want a house of their own: one long table, one fireplace, and the village or the slopes a few minutes away.

Service in the house.

A concierge prepares the stay, and private chefs, butlers and ski instructors can be arranged on request.

Good to know.

Each chalet is provided by its owner through our local partner in Megève. EverFlow arranges your stay; the terms of the house come with your proposal.
